research_integrity: Proof and self-contained reproducible finite tests supplied. No external or independent audit, priority certification, or general-purpose theorem-prover validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact counting is for labelled worlds in one complete S5 equivalence component and uniform Boolean valuations, not arbitrary S5 frames or general modal formulas. #P-completeness is under polynomial-time Turing reductions. Independence-equivalent four-vertex graphs and their nonisomorphism are known inputs, not novel graph theory. Modal model-counting equivalences might appear in prior literature under different terminology. Full bibliographic priority and independent proof audit have not been established.
title: Independence-polynomial completeness of model counting for an S5 co-occurrence fragment
